info.title: xls2xlsx
info.description: Command-line interface for the PowGrade.FileConverters.XlsToXlsx library.

options.name: --input
options.description: Input file, directory, or - for stdin

options.name: --output
options.description: Output filename (.xlsx or .xlsm), or - for stdout

options.name: --strict
options.description: Treat unknown formula tokens as errors and validate output package

options.name: --report
options.description: Print conversion diagnostics after conversion

options.name: --report-verbose
options.description: Print detailed diagnostics (warnings/issues/summaries)

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for encrypted XLS files

options.name: --recursive
options.description: Recursively scan subdirectories when input is a directory

options.name: --pattern
options.description: File search pattern for directory input (default: *.xls)

options.name: --include-regex
options.description: Include regex for directory input file names

options.name: --exclude-regex
options.description: Exclude regex for directory input file names

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Output directory for converted files

options.name: --output-ext
options.description: Output extension: xlsx or xlsm (default: xlsx)

options.name: --report-file
options.description: Write JSON conversion summary to file

options.name: --allowed-fidelity-loss
options.description: Allow at most this many fidelity-loss diagnostics

options.name: --fidelity-report-json
options.description: Write fidelity score artifact JSON to file

options.name: --fidelity-baseline-json
options.description: Compare current fidelity against a baseline artifact

options.name: --max-score-regression
options.description: Allow at most this much score regression vs baseline

options.name: --max-loss-increase
options.description: Allow at most this much fidelity-loss increase vs baseline

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print planned conversions without writing files

options.name: --flatten-output
options.description: Write all batch outputs directly under output-dir

options.name: --on-collision
options.description: Collision handling: fail or overwrite (default: fail)

options.name: --dump-colors
options.description: Inspect palette/fonts of an XLS file

options.name: --version
options.description: Show tool version

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this message
Stream mode:
If --input - is used and --output is omitted, converted XLSX bytes are written to stdout.
